# Welcome lettering

Self-hosted WOFF2 subsets from Google Fonts, limited to the five greeting words:

- [Caveat](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/caveat), weight 600: `hello`, `bonjour`, `hola`.
- [Kalam](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/kalam), regular: `नमस्ते`.
- [Yomogi](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/yomogi), regular: `こんにちは`.

Each font's SIL Open Font License is included beside it. The website makes no runtime request to Google Fonts. The combined font payload is about 14 KB.
